SRC-225:R001.text: Inspect closure evidence, source closure, post-verification changes, invalidation, knowledge/evidence dependencies, fingerprints, ownership/admission and current reconciliation. Distinguish classifications A-E only from evidence; preserve uncertainty about the FastPrompter incident and do not implement its application fixes.

SRC-225:R002.text: Associate closed verified Work and its source requirements with meaningful implementation dependencies and reproducible focused verification. Detect affected dependencies, recheck focused behavior, distinguish CURRENT_REGRESSION from byte-change suspicion and inability to verify, and preserve original historical evidence unchanged.

SRC-225:R003.text: Keep newly found defects under ordinary legal owned Work, reuse active successor repairs and create no duplicate tickets. Avoid rerunning every historical test after unrelated edits; bound record, path and byte work for large repositories; report exact unavailable-verification reasons; reuse existing vocabulary and RV journals rather than a parallel state machine.

SRC-225:R004.text: Exercise all eight negative controls: incorrect later implementation, removed dependency, deleted or weakened test, harmless formatting, behavior-preserving refactor, existing active successor repair, simultaneous agents, and immutable historical receipt with stale current validation. Changed bytes alone must not prove failure.

SRC-225:R005.text: Prefer safe degraded engineering operation. Suspected historical regression must not freeze unrelated Work, diagnostics or development. Block only the unsafe operation or violated integrity guarantee. Never silently treat confirmed regression as already VERIFIED; never rewrite source history.

SRC-225:R006.text: Run focused protocol tests, relevant lifecycle tests, unchanged before/after regression controls and supported full verification gates. Measure detection overhead. Document actual root cause, correction, false-positive and false-negative controls, limitations, and migration impact.

SRC-225:R007.text: No FastPrompter production edits, mass historical reopening, global byte-change stop, evidence deletion, fabricated Work identifiers, commit, tag, push, release or deployment.
